name: KoKoRead - Roald Dahl Kids Reading Quest
description: Gamified 15-minute daily reading platform adapting Roald Dahl and beloved children's classics (Charlie & the Chocolate Factory, Matilda, The Great Glass Elevator, Danny Champion of the World, The Magic Finger, Great Expectations, The Secret Garden, and Pollyanna) for ages 5-6, 7-8, and 9+ with KooBits rewards, quizzes, and AI Book Buddies.
